text: When Israel Went Out from EgyptWhen Israel went out from Egypt,The house of Jacob from a people of strange language,
Judah became His sanctuary,Israel, His dominion.
The sea looked and fled;The Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams,The hills, like lambs.
What disturbs you, O sea, that you flee?O Jordan, that you turn back?
O mountains, that you skip like rams?O hills, like lambs?
Tremble, O earth, before the Lord,Before the God of Jacob,
Who turned the rock into a pool of water,The flint into a spring of water.
